s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 血肉兽生成失败：
只有巫妖和死灵之躯能吞食
s.en: Only liches and necromantic bodies can devour it

s.zh: 没有正在冷却的死灵能力
s.en: No necromantic ability is on cooldown
Not enough twisted meat within 12 cells

s.zh: 打开后每天从地图上取
份扭曲肉喂给这名知识死灵：当天工作效率 +10%。没有扭曲肉就不喂，没有惩罚。
s.en: twisted meat from the map each day to feed this knowledge necro: work efficiency +10% for the day. Without twisted meat it isn't fed, with no penalty.

s.zh: 份扭曲肉：冷却最久的一个死灵能力（灵魂箭、恐惧凝视、律令死亡、寒冰射线、修补造物）立刻恢复。死灵之躯不会因此不舒服。
s.en: twisted meat within 12 cells: the necromantic ability with the longest cooldown (soul bolt, fear gaze, power word death, ray of frost, mend construct) recovers at once. Necromantic bodies feel no discomfort from it.

s.zh: 血肉孵化槽孵出了一只
s.en: The flesh incubation vat hatched a

s.zh: \n畸变巨像：唤醒后带“畸变血肉”（受伤 -17%、缓慢自愈、死亡时裂成 2 只小血肉兽）。
s.en: \nTwisted colossus: awakens with "twisted flesh" (damage taken -17%, slow self-healing, splits into 2 small flesh beasts on death).
